function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電的存在與性質）並不是由單一個人「發現」的，而是經過多位科學家在不同時期逐步揭示的。以下是幾位對電學發展具有關鍵貢獻的人物：

| 時代 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 1600s | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 首次將「電」與磁區分，提出「電流」概念，撰寫《De Magnete》 |
| 1700s | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 以閃電實驗證明電與雷電相同，提出正負電荷概念 |
| 1800s | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，證明電流可由化學反應產生 |
| 1800s | 亞歷山大·貝爾（Michael Faraday） | 發現電磁感應定律，奠定電動機與發電機的理論基礎 |
| 1800s | 朱塞佩·喬瓦尼（Giuseppe Guglielmo Marconi） | 研發無線電，將電波應用於通信 |

簡而言之，電力的「發現」是一個累積的歷史過程，從古代對靜電現象的觀察，到近代科學家對電荷、電流、磁場等概念的系統化研究，才形成了今天我們所熟知的電學體系。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can provide a concise answer: electricity was known historically but the discovery of its nature was by many. The question likely expects a historical figure like William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. The user didn't ask for calculation. So no function call. Just answer.
